# Build route without a college lab

3 October 2026. CURRENT PLANNING BASIS — NOT A FABRICATION OR ELECTRICAL RELEASE.

## What the user has clarified

**USER-REPORTED:** college and NGO can provide money, not lab facilities. Pune, Hyderabad or Mumbai are possible build/test locations; no specific premises are confirmed. An ENTC engineer may review the work, but availability and review scope are not confirmed. The assistant still prepares the design, calculations, component comparisons, drawings and software; that person is not the project delivery dependency.

Funding availability is not a quotation, purchase authorization or confirmed amount. The outdoor tower/network remains the long-term goal; first physical validation is indoors.

## Responsibilities: no handoff of the design work

| Work | Preparation owner | Physical delivery / acceptance |
|---|---|---|
| Requirements, component comparisons and pressure budget | Assistant + user decisions and supplier evidence | User confirms requirements; suppliers identify exact products |
| Mechanical CAD, tolerances, calculations and assembly drawings | Assistant develops and verifies digital package | Suitably qualified mechanical reviewer checks release; local shop fabricates reviewed drawings |
| Electrical/control drawings, ratings calculations and sensor integration | Assistant prepares OEM-based drafts and software | Optional ENTC reviewer checks within demonstrated competence; qualified electrical professional reviews/assembles/commissions the mains installation |
| Measurements and analysis software | Assistant | Team records actual readings; paid instrument operator/testing provider where needed |
| Funding, site access and purchases | User/team | User approves orders and contracts; college/NGO funding only |

No particular reviewer has been hired or assigned. An ENTC degree alone does not establish the scope of electrical installation authorization or structural competence. If the friend is unavailable, procure the required qualified review as a service. Assistant output is preparation, not professional sign-off or physical inspection.

## Practical recommendation: core first, appearance second

Complete and review the full-size **guarded fan/filter core**, sealed housing and supporting frame before committing to the decorative cylindrical casing. This is a proposed build sequence, not an architecture freeze or a smaller replacement for the tower.

The core still requires a safe enclosure, guards, reviewed supports, sealed access, electrical compartment, stable base and commissioning. It is NOT an exposed spinning-fan demonstration. Simplifying the cosmetic shell must not remove a pressure boundary, guard, electrical protection, support or required weather protection.

REASONING: existing mass studies identify a heavy cosmetic casing; real fan/filter dimensions and closures remain unsettled. Deferring its finish may avoid redoing expensive curved metalwork. Its final presence can still affect airflow, access, weight and noise, so retest the completed tower configuration. Old CFD and the unclad core's results do not automatically transfer.

## Buy, rent, hire—not borrow from college

| Package | Recommended route | Required before spending |
|---|---|---|
| Fan, coarse filter and HEPA | Buy standard OEM components after exact selection | Exact current SKU, clean/loaded curves, mounting/orientation, mass, drawings, warranty and quote |
| Frame, housing, hatches, ducts and guards | Hire sheet-metal/HVAC fabricator | Mechanical-reviewed drawings, materials/joints, service access and inspection scope |
| Power/control enclosure | Hire qualified electrical assembler; buy rated components | OEM circuit, actual supply/site, reviewed ratings/protection, wiring and commissioning scope |
| Two room particle monitors | Buy ready-to-log instruments or complete supported USB kits | Exact kit contents, host compatibility, data export, traceability, reference-comparison plan and quote |
| Filter-pressure measurement | Buy a suitable calibrated instrument/logger; rent for commissioning if preferable | Actual required range, accuracy, tubing/taps, sign/reference check and calibration |
| Room temperature/humidity and dimensions | Buy modest logging/tape instruments | Appropriate range/method and documentation |
| Airflow, power, sound and installed filter integrity | Hire an equipped testing service or rent suitable equipment with competent operator | Written scope, methods, calibration, applicable limits, raw data and reporting; tower suitability confirmed |

Do not buy every laboratory instrument for one prototype. Commissioning/test services are planned budget items, not free college resources. Provider availability, cost, lead time and willingness to test a student tower remain UNKNOWN.

## A concrete low-voltage monitoring candidate

**OEM FACT:** [SEK-SPS30 product page](https://sensirion.com/products/catalog/SEK-SPS30), checked 3 October 2026, lists one SPS30 and a UART-to-USB adapter cable in the kit. Two complete kits are a proposed two-position route using the existing laptop, rather than bare sensors on a shared I2C bus. Confirm the exact supplied kit revision and simultaneous Windows operation with the supplier before ordering.

[Sensirion ControlCenter](https://sensirion.com/products/sensor-evaluation/control-center), checked 3 October 2026, lists plotting and logging. Its export/EDF-to-project conversion and operation with the delivered two-kit setup remain untested here. No software installed and no kit selected or ordered. Do not buy an extra SensorBridge, Raspberry Pi or custom PCB unless the exact supplied configuration actually needs it.

This can be a separate reviewed low-voltage data-acquisition activity before tower completion. It is not fan commissioning, sensor calibration, evidence of filter efficiency or a physical tower test. Housing/orientation and environmental suitability must follow the instrument instructions.

## Paid-service leads across the three possible cities

**DETECTED PUBLIC CLAIMS, not verified competence or an endorsement:** pages checked 3 October 2026. No provider contacted. No claim of accreditation, quote, accepted tower scope or booking.

| City | Public lead | What its own page advertises |
|---|---|---|
| Pune | [Cleantech Solutions](https://www.cleantechsolutions.in/validation.html) | Airflow volume, HEPA integrity, pressure differential and noise measurements |
| Hyderabad | [Galaxy International Corp](https://gicorp.in/service-validation/) | High-efficiency filter integrity and specialized validation services |
| Mumbai | [Coolair Systems](https://coolairsystem.co.in/services/hvac-measurement-analysis) | Air-volume and static-pressure measurement with performance reports |

These are leads for scope/quote enquiries, not all-in-one confirmed tower builders. In particular, Mumbai airflow service is not evidence of HEPA leak-test capability. Request instrument/calibration details, sample report, method and exact applicability. If an accredited report is needed, verify current certificate and exact scope through [NABL](https://nabl-india.org/); do not accept a generic badge as coverage for every test. No self-administered aerosol challenge is proposed.

## What to quote now, and what to release later

Use [the funded work-package sheet](FUNDED_WORK_PACKAGES.csv) alongside [supplier questions](SUPPLIER_RELEASE_QUESTIONS.md) and [hatch review package](M05_CLOSURE_REVIEW_PACKAGE.md).

1. Obtain component information and itemized quotations; preparation of requests is allowed, but none have been sent. Confirm a candidate test room and build premises before freight/installation commitments.
2. Assistant completes component-specific core drawings, pressure budget, structure/service and electrical design calculations as evidence arrives. Optional ENTC feedback is incorporated and revisioned.
3. Qualified reviewers resolve identified issues; user approves frozen BOM/drawings, contracts and purchases. Do not fabricate from current study STEP.
4. Shop assembles the reviewed core; qualified electrical person inspects and commissions. Testing service records airflow/losses/power/noise and installed integrity under approved methods.
5. Team performs reviewed repeated indoor trials using traceable instruments and the recorder. Add cosmetic cylinder and recheck final configuration. Outdoor weather/public-safety/site design and pilot follow separately.

This sequence can proceed without a university lab or the optional friend. It cannot proceed honestly without actual component/site facts and physical checks. No fixed delivery date or percentage promised.

## Immediate work priorities here

Focus next design work on exact fan/filter selection and a practical reviewed core assembly, not more presentation software. Actual OEM responses, site supply/room details, selected hardware and reviewer scope are still open inputs. No supplier correspondence, purchase, specialist engagement, fabrication or physical measurement has occurred in this transition.
